name: pr-create-card
title: Pull request card
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A diff chip that opens into a pull request and a commit rail. The host passes the data.

meta.descriptionEs: Un chip con el diff que se abre en la tarjeta del pull request y su riel de commits.

examples.title: Tarjeta de pull request
examples.description: Chip, riel y variante compacta. Taller Ladrillo.

examples.title: Marco de estrés
examples.description: 390 px, 320 px, texto de 60 caracteres y vacío.

meta.usage: <PrCreateCard title="Keep the folio" number={42} state="open" diffStat={{ add: 86, del: 12 }} commits={commits} />

api.name: title / number / state
api.description: creating, open, merged, closed, or error.

api.name: diffStat / commits
api.description: The chip and the rail. Both come from the host.

api.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
api.description: Controlled or uncontrolled. Closed unless opened.

api.name: variant
api.description: rail is the chosen default. compact is the two-column alternative.

api.name: labels
api.description: English by default. prCreateCardLabelsEs is es-MX.

api.name: errorMessage / className
api.description: Visible error text. The state word is not color alone.

docs: Clean-room. Idea only, no license: the interaction comes from Phil Pitus, Generative UI #6 (https://x.com/pitus_/status/2117270206464631028). No source, copy, layout, or assets were copied. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite badge. The item ships no theme. Motion is opacity and transform only, and it stops when the reader prefers reduced motion. English labels are the default; prCreateCardLabelsEs is es-MX.
